entries.toelichting: Adjective (Gen 11:30 (Sarai); 25:21 (Rebekah); 29:31 (Rachel); Ex 23:26; Deu 7:14; Jdg 13:2,3 (Samson's mother); 1Sa 2:5 (Hannah); Job 24:21; Pss 113:9; Isa 54:1). 12 occurrences. Standard.

Canaanite city (Num 21:1; 33:40; Jos 12:14; Jdg 1:16). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated.

Standard. The Levitical-incest formulary 'uncovering of nakedness' (Lev 18-20) preserves the technical-cultic-purity sense.

Used (Job 35:9; Ecc 4:1; Lam 1:9 (variant); Pro 14:23 (variant)). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated.

Used (Deu 1:4; Jos 9:10; 12:4; 13:12,31; 1Chr 6:71 [56]; etc.). 4 occurrences. Place. English convention.
Same place / variant; deity-grove (Jdg 2:13; 10:6; 1Sa 7:3,4; 12:10; 31:10). 12 occurrences. English convention.
Used (Esth 3:14; 8:13; Job 3:8; 15:24; Deu 32:35 (variant); Isa 10:13; 30:8 (variant)). 7 occurrences. Hyphenated.

Queen-mother of Judah (2Ki 8:26; 11:1-20; 1Chr 8:26; 2Chr 22:2-12; 23:12,13,21; 24:7; Ezr 8:7). 17 occurrences. English convention.
First judge of Israel (Jos 15:17; Jdg 1:13; 3:9,11; 1Chr 4:13; 11:15 (variant); 27:15). 7 occurrences. English convention.

Verb (Lev 19:23,24 (variant); Deu 24:20 (variant); Job 26:8 (variant); Pss 149:4; Isa 10:15; 44:23; 49:3; 55:5; 60:7,9,13,21; 61:3; Eze 16:7 (variant)). 13 occurrences. Standard.
Used (Joe 2:6; Nah 2:11 [10]; Lam 4:8 (variant); Isa 13:8). 3 occurrences. Hyphenated.

Used (Gen 46:13; Ex 1:15; Num 26:23; Jdg 10:1; 1Chr 7:1). 4 occurrences. English convention.
Used (Gen 45:26; Pss 38:9 [8]; 77:3 [2]; Hab 1:4; Lam 2:18 (variant)). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated.
African nation (Gen 10:6; 1Chr 1:8; Eze 27:10; 30:5; 38:5; Jer 46:9; Nah 3:9). 7 occurrences. English convention.
Captain of Pharaoh's guard (Gen 37:36; 39:1). 2 occurrences. English convention.
Priest of On (Gen 41:45,50; 46:20). 3 occurrences. English convention.
Tiglath-Pileser III (2Ki 15:19; 1Chr 5:26; Isa 66:19). 4 occurrences. English convention.
Used twice (Jer 10:4; Hab 1:6 (variant); Isa 28:7). 2 occurrences. Standard.
Used (Esth 3:7; 9:24,26 (twice),28,29,31,32). 8 occurrences. Means 'lot' (cast for date of pogrom). English convention.
Hapax (Esth 9:8). Son of Haman. English convention.
Verb (Mal 3:20 [4:2]; Nah 3:18; Hab 1:8; Jer 50:11). 4 occurrences. Hyphenated.
Used (1Ki 10:18; Job 28:17; Pss 19:11 [10]; 21:4 [3]; 119:127; Pro 8:19; Song 5:11,15; Isa 13:12; Lam 4:2). 9 occurrences. Hyphenated.

Verb (Pss 18:15 [14] (variant); 53:6 [5] (variant); 68:2 [1] (variant); 89:11 [10]; 141:7 (variant); 142:5 [4] (variant); Job 38:24 (variant); 40:11 (variant); Pro 5:16; 11:24; 13:9 (variant); Isa 24:1 (variant); Hab 3:14 (variant)). 10 occurrences. Hyphenated.
